title: Set-Aside Desk Guidance: Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve Allowance on a Re-Filed Extension Request in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Rule.** For a further extension request re-filed on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case, the loan's Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve, held among the borrower's Set-Aside Accounts, adds days to the requested length:

- Where the reserve is active but holds less than one year's property tax and hazard premium on file, 7 calendar days are added for clearing the coming charges at closing.
- Where that reserve is depleted, 14 calendar days are added.
- Otherwise nothing is added.

One year's charges are the annual property tax plus the annual hazard premium on file for the reserve. The reserve's holding is its balance.

| Reserve status | Balance compared with one year's tax and hazard premium | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| active | below | 7 |
| active | equal or above | 0 |
| depleted | any | 14 |
| any other status, or no reserve | any | 0 |

## Both sides (hypothetical)

Annual property tax 4,200.00 and annual hazard premium 1,800.00 give 6,000.00 of yearly charges.

- An active reserve with a balance of 5,999.99: 7 days are added.
- An active reserve with a balance of 6,000.00: nothing is added.
